items.title: James Moody — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And they tell me that he played with Connie Bradshaw [phonetic sp.] off and on or something.

ctx.x: And I thought that he played trumpet. And they tell me that he played with Connie Bradshaw [phonetic sp.] off and on or something. But I thought I got my music -- to like music -- from my father, but I got it from my mother because she the one that had the Chick Webb records, and Jimmie Lunceford, Count Basie, you know, the records of that time because she liked jazz, you know. So I really got my musical likes from my mother, I think. And my mother played piano at -- in the church, so -- because we -- I was born…
And when did you move from Georgia to Pennsylvania?
